title: MoralReason: Generalizable Moral Decision Alignment For LLM Agents Using Reasoning-Level Reinforcement Learning

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the alignment of LLM agents with secular moral decision frameworks, specifically utilitarianism, deontology, and virtue ethics. It does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
